Utah lawmakers unveil draft legislation aimed at regulating police use of surveillance technology
summary: Lawmakers unveiled draft legislation Wednesday that would impose new transparency requirements on law enforcement that uses automatic license plate reader systems.

title: Utah receives $11M from Department of Energy for grid infrastructure projects
summary: The Beehive State is bolstering its electrical grid by way of a $11 million grant from the U.S. Department of Energy.
